description: ARM storage account whose network rules default to Allow
note: CIS Azure 4.7 and 4.8. defaultAction Allow makes every firewall rule on the account decoration, and bypass None additionally cuts off the trusted Azure services. Relabelled 2026-09-23 when KICS replaced Trivy on ARM and Bicep: Trivy's ARM adapter could not satisfy four of its own checks (docs/trivy-azure-arm-adapter-gap.md), so the trivy:AZU-* labels here are gone and the KICS query that covers the same control takes their place. KICS raises three separate queries here where Trivy raised two, and it covers 4.8 (trusted services) on both languages, which AZU-0010 only did on ARM. CORRECTED after the confirming run: KICS's Trusted Microsoft Services query was expected here for the 4.8 half and does not fire, for exactly the reason checkov's CKV_AZURE_36 does not -- both gate it on defaultAction being Deny, and with Allow there is nothing to bypass. Two independent tools agreeing on that makes it the rule rather than a quirk. 4.8 is exercised by the insecure-transfer cases instead, where the account declares no networkAcls at all.
